sentences.text: Coprobacter fastidiosus is a Gram-negative obligate anaerobic bacterium of the phylum Bacteroidetes, and its type strain was isolated from human infant faeces.
Coprobacter secundus was described from a culture-based study of the faecal microbiome of two adult female subjects.
Its type strain ferments a rich collection of carbohydrate substrates, produces acetic acid as a terminal product and is resistant to bile.
Coprobacter tertius was later described from an isolate cultured from the faeces of a patient attending a hospital breast care clinic.
A subspecies, Coprobacter secundus subsp. similis, was proposed for a strain isolated from the faecal sample of a healthy Japanese man.
